Who I Am

About Me

I'm Giriraj J, a Cardiac physiologist-in-training with hands-on clinical exposure in interventional cardiology, critical care, and non-invasive diagnostics.

Currently completed B.Sc Cardiac Technology at Vinayaka Mission's Research Foundation – DU (CGPA 8.5) and Interning at Aster CMI Hospital, Bangalore (Dec 2025 – Dec 2026) with expertise across cardiac, neuro, and vascular domains.

My mission is to bridge cutting-edge cardiac imaging technology with compassionate patient care — especially in structural heart procedures and electrophysiology.

Clinical Expertise

Cath Lab Procedures

🩺

Coronary Angiogram (CAG)

Diagnostic imaging of coronary arteries. Multiple views, contrast injection timing, and hemodynamic monitoring throughout.

Interventional Cardiology
🔧

Angioplasty (PTCA)

Interventional Cardiology
🔬

Intra Vascular Imaging

IVUS, HD IVUS, OCT. High-resolution coronary lesion assessment. Trained in machine operation and image interpretation for clinical decision-making.

Advanced Imaging
🔗

Advanced PCI

Skilled in complex coronary interventions with hands-on expertise in 30+ PCI techniques, including ELCA (Excimer Laser Coronary Atherectomy), Rotablation, and Orbital Atherectomy. Experienced in managing heavily calcified, complex, and high-risk coronary lesions using advanced interventional strategies and imaging-guided procedures.

Complex PCI
🔋

Pacemaker & Rhythm management

PPI, TPI, Micra leadless pacemaker, AICD, CRT-D procedures. Device programming, defibrillation thresholds, and post-implant checks.

Device Implantation
🫀

Structural Heart Procedures

TAVI, PTMC, BAV, BPV, VSD & ASD closure. Complex structural work requiring fluoroscopic guidance and team coordination.

Structural Cardiology
🧠

Neurointervention

Cerebral DSA, intracranial coiling, carotid stenting, MMA embolization, and AVM embolization across neuroradiology suite.

Neuro Intervention

Credentials

My Certificates

❤️‍🔥

Basic Life Support (BLS)

Emergency Care
SaveaLife – NHCPS (Accredited)

Covers high-quality CPR for adults, children, and infants, AED usage, and relief of foreign-body airway obstruction. Essential first-response skill for any cardiac care environment.

🚨

Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS)

Emergency Care
SaveaLife – NHCPS (Accredited)

Advanced protocols for managing cardiac arrest, stroke, and other life-threatening emergencies. Includes rhythm recognition, pharmacology, and team-based resuscitation algorithms.

👶

Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS)

Emergency Care
SaveaLife – NHCPS (Accredited)

Systematic approach to pediatric assessment and resuscitation. Covers recognition and management of respiratory distress, shock, and cardiac arrest in infants and children.

🩹

First Aid & AED Techniques

Emergency Care
SaveaLife – NHCPS (Accredited)

Comprehensive training in wound care, fracture management, choking response, and Automated External Defibrillator (AED) operation for sudden cardiac arrest response.

☢️

Radiation Protection Course

Radiation Safety
ISRRT (International Society of Radiographers)

Covers principles of radiation protection including ALARA, shielding techniques, dosimetry, and occupational exposure limits essential for safe Cath Lab and fluoroscopy practice.

📉

Radiation Dose Reduction Techniques

Radiation Safety
ISRRT

Specialized training in techniques to minimize patient and operator radiation exposure during interventional procedures — including collimation, pulsed fluoroscopy, and positioning strategies.

🗑️

Biomedical Waste Management

Clinical Compliance
VMRF-DU (Vinayaka Mission's Research Foundation)

Training in classification, segregation, handling, and disposal of biomedical waste as per Indian regulatory guidelines (BMW Rules 2016) — critical for hospital infection control and compliance.

📈

ECG Recognition of Arrhythmias

Cardiology
Dosily

Systematic ECG interpretation covering sinus rhythms, atrial and ventricular arrhythmias, heart blocks, and pacemaker rhythms — directly applicable to Cath Lab and ICU monitoring.

🫀

Cardiac Surgery

Cardiology
Dosily

Overview of cardiac surgical procedures including CABG, valve replacements, and congenital heart defect corrections — providing foundational knowledge for perioperative cardiac care.

🎓

Cardiology Training

Academic
UCLA Health

Comprehensive cardiology training covering cardiovascular anatomy, pathophysiology, diagnostic imaging, and evidence-based management of common cardiac conditions from a world-class institution.

⚖️

Medical Law

Academic – Silver Badge
NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning)

Covers medicolegal frameworks governing healthcare in India — including patient rights, consent, medical negligence, professional liability, and ethical obligations of healthcare workers.
